headline: Lence Pte. Ltd. Files SEBI Takeover Disclosure for AWL Agri Business Limited
sum: Lence Pte. Ltd. has filed a Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure with NSE/SEBI regarding acquisition of shares in AWL Agri Business Limited, triggering mandatory takeover code compliance.
detail: Lence Pte. Ltd., a Singapore-registered entity, disclosed its acquisition of shares in AWL Agri Business Limited under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure was submitted to NSE on 8 May 2026. The filing indicates a trigger event requiring immediate regulatory compliance and potential public announcement of an open offer depending on the acquisition threshold crossed and applicable exemptions.
